title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #5 OPERATION SPECTRUM OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #5 OPERATION SPECTRUM OPEN
DURATION: November 11, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 25, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10
SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different "Contracts" to clear stages, complete challenges, improve level evaluation, and collect "Contract Bounty" and "Operation Agreement."
- "Contract Bounty" can be used to redeem rewards in "Secret Sanctuary."
- "Operation Agreement" can be used to unlock more Contingency Contract contents.
CROSS-SEASON " SECRET SANCTUARY" OPEN
- Cross-Season Permanent Trade Center New Arrivals:
MARTHE Collection - Shoal Beat for Blue Poison
EPOQUE Collection - Letters from Wessex for Melantha (Re-edition)
Season #5 Furniture - Spectrum Pennant
- Season #5 Special Trade Center Supplies: Elite Materials, LMD, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Chips, etc.
DURATION: November 11, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 25, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
NOTE:
- You do not need Sanity to play Contingency Contract stages.
- You need a certain number of completed Contracts to unlock some other Contracts. Please note that the number of completed Contracts DOES NOT EQUAL to Contingency Level.

- Compared with Season #4, Season #5 still has 8 sites in total, but has replaced 2 sites from the previous Season. There will be a new Rotating Site and a new Permanent Site, and the Permanent Site from last Season will be added into Rotating Sites. During the season, there will be 1 Permanent Site and 7 Rotating Sites (rotating daily) for you to challenge. (The first Rotating Site's rotation time and its corresponding challenges on the first day of the event will be extended by 1 day.)
- Several new Contracts and challenges will be added to the Season's Permanent Site on November 18, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- After Season #5 ends, the unused Contract Bounty will be retained.
- After Season #5 ends, all the Operation Agreements you have collected this season will be automatically converted into Operation Spectrum Supplies, the ratio is 1:1.
- During Season #5, you will receive Credits if your Support Units have helped others in clearing their Contingency Contract stages.
- During Season #5, players can obtain Season #5 Engraved Medal Set by achieving related goals.
02 SUPPLIES & CHIPS EVERYDAY ACCESS
DURATION: November 11, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 25, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
03 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DURATION: November 11, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 25, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, "Joint Operation", opens and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6* and 5* Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Thorns / Nightingale / Suzuran / Weedy
★★★★★: Nearl / Andreana / Silence / Franka / Elysium / Leonhardt
04 RHODES KITCHEN COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: November 11, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 25, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Rhodes Kitchen Collection - Shaved-Ice Memories for Magallan
Rhodes Kitchen Collection - Bibliosmia for Istina
Rhodes Kitchen Collection - Honey Pilferer for Beehunter
